ceph-aiops v0.1.0 (initial preview release)

- Introduces standalone, governed Ceph operations via the ceph-mgr Dashboard REST API.
- Provides 35 tools (17 read, 18 write) covering Ceph health, OSDs, placement groups, pools, RBD, CephFS, RGW, monitors/managers, slow ops, and capacity forecasting.
- All write operations are audited, gated by policy, risk-tiered, and support undo/dry-run with double confirmation.
- Secrets (dashboard passwords) are securely stored encrypted, never in plaintext.
- Compatible with vanilla ceph-mgr (cephadm, Proxmox, MicroCeph); no Kubernetes or croit requirements.
- PREVIEW: Tools are mock-validated; live cluster verification is recommended for production use.
